body:
Kevin Hart’s longtime friend and personal trainer Ron “Boss” Everline gifted him a brand-new G-Wagon… with a booster seat in the front 😂😂

@justtrain shared a video of the surprise, making sure Kevin noticed the extra accessory: “Car seat in here for you… check out the baby seat, the booster seat.”

Kevin wasn’t having it: “Why do you think that’s cool? I’m not sitting in this.” 😭

Boss made sure to clarify: “It’s brand new, by the way. I bought it.”

After 14 years of friendship, workouts, and trash talk, even a gift this big had to come with a height joke 😂🙏
